title: Volve field Daily Drilling Report DDR-TEST-00075 — wellbore not published in this release
source_system: Equinor Volve / public DDR release — Volve field Daily Drilling
excerpt:
00:00 - 03:00: Continued milling 10 3/4" CH from 141,51mmd to 141,58mmd. 2000 LPM/15 bar, 80-120rpm/4-25knm, 3-6ton wob, ROP 2,3 cm/hr. Observed 170ltrs gain, MAX 3ppm h2s in fluid and a small gas peak at 141,54mmd, indicating that casing parted from CH. Experienced vibrations and string stalling out several times.
03:00 - 03:15: Picked up mill above CH. Stopped rotation and slided down through CH. Took weight at depth where milling was stopped.
03:15 - 04:00: Continued milling from 141,58 mmd to 141,66 mmd 10cm past mark on DP). Stalled out several times and experienced vibrations at surface.
04:00 - 04:15: Attempted to slide through CH. Took weight at depth where milling was stopped.
04:15 - 04:30: Lined over to TT and performed TBT for drops check after severe vibrations.
04:30 - 05:15: Lined over to TT. Performed drops check of TDS and in BOP area.
05:15 - 05:45: Circulated 2 x b/u at 3000 LPM 30 bar. 1,5kg swarf on ditch magnets on flowline.
05:45 - 07:00: POOH with milling BHA
07:00 - 07:15: Performed TBT for l/d milling BHA

08:45 - 09:00: P/u and m/u 12 1/4" flat bottom mill and RIH to 36 mmd.
09:00 - 09:45: Checked TDS after milling operation. Found hydraulic leak and repaired same.
09:45 - 11:15: RIH with flat bottom mill from 36 mmd to 135 mmd

sections.text: Continued milling 10 3/4" CH from 141,51mmd to 141,58mmd. 2000 LPM/15 bar, 80-120rpm/4-25knm, 3-6ton wob, ROP 2,3 cm/hr. Observed 170ltrs gain, MAX 3ppm h2s in fluid and a small gas peak at 141,54mmd, indicating that casing parted from CH. Experienced vibrations and string stalling out several times.
Picked up mill above CH. Stopped rotation and slided down through CH. Took weight at depth where milling was stopped.
Continued milling from 141,58 mmd to 141,66 mmd 10cm past mark on DP). Stalled out several times and experienced vibrations at surface.
Attempted to slide through CH. Took weight at depth where milling was stopped.
Lined over to TT and performed TBT for drops check after severe vibrations.
Lined over to TT. Performed drops check of TDS and in BOP area.
Circulated 2 x b/u at 3000 LPM 30 bar. 1,5kg swarf on ditch magnets on flowline.
POOH with milling BHA
Performed TBT for l/d milling BHA
B/o XO, l/d 8 1/4" DC single and r/b 2 ea STD 8 1/4" DC.
P/u and m/u 12 1/4" flat bottom mill and RIH to 36 mmd.
Checked TDS after milling operation. Found hydraulic leak and repaired same.
RIH with flat bottom mill from 36 mmd to 135 mmd
Established circulation and recorded up/down weight 86/83 ton. Established parameters 80 RPM 1-4 KNM, 2000 LPM 15 bar. RIH and tagged top of hanger at 139,7 mmd.
Worked through CH. 40 140 RPM 3 30knm, 2000 LPM 15 bar. Worked down 40 cm. Experienced vibrations at surface. String stalled out several times.
Tagged top of casing at 141,7 mmd 1,5m below CH). Dressed off 10cm from top of casing. 100 RPM 3-8 KNM, 2000 LPM 14 bar.
Circulated 1 x b/u at 3500 LPM 40 bar.

POOH 1 STD. Attmpted to break out TDS. Broke between upper and lower IBOP. Used work basket to assess situation and performed drops check. Spun in main shaft to lower IBOP. Lowered string and set in slips.
Performed TBT for changing saver sub
Changed saver sub and m/u to lower IBOP.
Performed TBT for changing saver sub with new ongoing crew meanwhile prepared new saver sub.
Spun in shaft to IBOP, lifted pipe handler into position and m\u saver sub to IBOP 88knm m/u torque ring and installed lock-ring.
Performed drops check on TDS.
Adjusted pipe handler on TDS.
Performed TBT for POOH with milling BHA
POOH 1 STD and r/b. L/o pup joint
Continued to POOH. Unable to b/o xover on 8 1/4 DC due to over-torque, MAX 160knm. Changed out dies on IRN and attempted to b/o. M/u lift-sub and r/b DC with XO installed.
POOH w/ BHA to 27 mmd, r/b 8 1/4" DC.
